input.change_text: *(tasks)* avoid dropping completed task results during collection ([#639](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk/pull/639))

output.subject: rmcp tasks no longer drop completed results during collection
output.action_text: Upgrade `rmcp` to 0.15.0+ if your server uses the task surface. Pre-fix the collection step could drop completed task results — silent data-loss mode, no error raised, caller saw a missing result. No workaround on 0.14 and earlier other than the upgrade.
